title: Map current screens to typed feature view models
objective: Inspect the current mock-driven Expo screens and define the smallest screen-to-feature-hook/view-model migration that preserves routing, glass, accessibility, and role separation.
acceptance_criteria: Every screen using mock data is mapped to a hook or local-only state
Caregiver and patient data/auth boundaries stay separate
Existing navigation and glass abstractions remain intact
Proposed migration identifies loading, empty, stale, offline, retry, and failed-write states
